messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3777777 - tenant cascade (vpc-dedicated-42) experiencing sustained tail latency and token slowdowns. Severity: P1. Trigger: 95th token latency > 2s for 4m. Paging: eng-oncall. Link: https://infra.redwood/incident/3777777
Sasha: ack, I'm taking. any immediate customer impact known? @customer-ops?
customer-ops: Cascade reports timeouts on document-summarize route, some 504s from their edge. They see spike starting ~09:03 UTC. Not all users impacted, subset of requests with >8k tokens.
Riya: jumping in. grabbing metrics, tail latency distro and queue sizes.
Ben: possible culprit — bespoke batching knob for Cascade was lowered last week for memory constraints: `max_batch_tokens` set to 1024 on pool-dedicated-42. With long requests, we might be fragmenting and sending tiny batches -> high per-token overhead.
Sasha: ok, two parallel mitigations: 1) isolate Cascade traffic to a separate shuttle to avoid hurting neighbors, 2) temporarily raise `max_batch_tokens` to 4096 and relax scheduler churn. will coordinate.
Mike-platform: I can carve out a tenant-isolate route now. running: `redwood ctl route update --tenant cascade --pool dedicated-42 --isolate true`
incident-bot: action logged: route update requested by mike-platform at 09:08 UTC.
Riya: pulling per-shard queue lengths: some queues hit 50-100 pending requests, average batch size dropped to 1-2 sequences. attaching quick sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T09:07:58Z pool=dedicated-42 tenant=cascade queue_len=92 batch_size=1 tokens=7800 latency=2.6s
2026-03-15T09:08:03Z pool=dedicated-42 tenant=cascade batch_size=1 scheduling_delay=300ms exec_ms=2400
```
Sasha: confirms fragmentation. Ben, can we do a hot-config flip to bump max_batch_tokens? also change `scheduler.min_fill_ms` to 10ms -> 30ms to allow more coalesce.
Ben: I can push a safe knob change via runtime API: `POST /internal/pools/dedicated-42/knobs` payload below. Will instrument.
Ben: config snippet I'm about to apply:
```
{
  "tenant": "cascade",
  "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
  "scheduler": {
    "min_fill_ms": 30,
    "max_wait_ms": 80
  },
  "shaper": {
    "enable_prefix_cache": true
  }
}
```
Sasha: do it, but first add a guard: revert after 10m if tail latency doesn't improve or if GPU mem OOMs. set an alert.
Ben: applying now (dry-run check passed). `curl -XPOST https://runtime.internal/pools/dedicated-42/knobs -d @payload.json` -> 202 Accepted.
incident-bot: config-change recorded by Ben at 09:10 UTC: knobs updated for tenant cascade.
Mike-platform: isolation route applied, traffic pinned to shuttle-s3 (warm instances), throughput should be stable.
Riya: metrics showing batch_size median climbing from 1 to ~6 after ~30s. 95th token latency dropping. posting chart link: https://obs.redwood/charts/3777777
Sasha: customer-ops, can you ask Cascade to validate their failing job? small window for testing.
customer-ops: they ran two jobs, one succeeded, one still timed out (different shard). They said the success latency fell from ~3s to ~0.6s.
Ben: monitoring memory headroom: one instance reported GPU memory at 88% after change, within safe margin (threshold 92%). no OOMs in logs so far.
Riya: tail p95 timeline: 09:07: 2.6s, 09:09: 1.1s, 09:12: 0.65s. queue depth trending down.
Sasha: nice. leaving a mitigation note: increased max_batch_tokens + slight scheduler delay to coalesce. Will keep in effect for 20m and then roll back to a tuned mid value with follow-up.
Ben: will create a follow-up ticket to profile request length distribution and recommend a permanent knob: `max_batch_tokens=2048` + adaptive coalescer for long requests.
Mike-platform: adding a temporary ingress throttle rule to protect neighbors in case traffic spikes again: `rate_limit tenant=cascade 200r/s burst=50` applied.
incident-bot: note added to incident 3777777: ingress throttle applied by mike-platform at 09:15 UTC.
Riya: running a quick load replay to confirm stability. replay 1k requests over 30s -> average latency 0.72s, 99th=1.8s. no errors.
Sasha: handoff plan: I'll stay for the next 25m, then hand to the overnight oncall if stable. Ben & Mike, please push follow-up RFC with perf numbers. customer-ops, inform Cascade that we left knobs elevated temporarily and will revert after validation window.
customer-ops: relayed to Cascade. they asked if we can make these config changes permanent; we told them we'll propose safe defaults after postmortem. they appreciated the quick action. :thumbsup:
Ben: created ticket INFR-5231 with perf diffs and proposed knobs.
incident-bot: incident 3777777 severity reduced to P2 at 09:28 UTC based on improved latency and decreased errors.
Sasha: closing notes: root cause likely conservative `max_batch_tokens` combined with long-request workload from Cascade after feature rollout. short-term fix applied. follow-up: adapt coalescer and tenant profiling. leaving thread open until rollback window completes.
customer-ops: thanks team. marking as monitoring. :white_check_mark:
Riya: monitoring looks clean at 09:35 UTC, queue depths normal, no regressions. I'll update metrics snapshot in ticket.
Sasha: handing to night oncall @mike-platform in ~20m for observation. if anything flares, page P1.
mike-platform: ack, watching.
